sentiment: Twelve years pass in the same small square of sky, and the world keeps turning whether or not anyone is watching.

stories.title: Mike Tomlin spent 12 years building a Minecraft city
stories.summary: An NFL coach spent over a decade, block by block, building a city nobody in his day job would ever see. The work is real whether or not it has an audience — devotion measured in patience rather than attention.

stories.title: A 12-year sequence of telescope images of a star and four planets orbiting
stories.summary: Twelve years of the same patch of sky, stacked into a single moving picture: four worlds carving slow arcs around their star. The image only exists because someone kept looking after the first look was no longer interesting.
